message: The other day, I was rummaging through my pantry, looking for some emergency snacks for the upcoming storm. I found a can of beans that had a birthday before my grandson was born! I laughed at myself—who knew canned goods could age so gracefully? It’s a gentle reminder that having some supplies on hand is great, but keeping them fresh is even better. Maybe I should start a 'pantry birthday party' to keep track! 🎉
